title: GeneratedWorkerSpec
description: The SPEC for a durable verifier worker a codegen agent proposed (the M4 rung) — what it WOULD become, not an active worker. It REQUIRES proof_scripts (the proofs that must pass before it could ever be registered), an idempotency_key_template (so re-runs collapse, not duplicate), and a retry/DLQ policy (durable execution discipline). It rides the EXISTING durable worker framework — it never defines a 2nd runtime. registration_status is pinned [proposed]: in the lean core nothing auto-registers/executes; MAIN integrates and a proof gate + (for high-risk) human approval stands between this spec and any execution. Deterministic when created_at is injected.

spec_id.description: content-addressed over (verification_recipe_id, extractor_snippet_id); version in metadata, never in the id

verification_recipe_id.description: the VerificationRecipe this worker would run (lineage)

extractor_snippet_id.description: the proof-gated ExtractorSnippet this worker would execute (lineage)

rides_existing_worker_framework.description: PINNED true — a generated worker rides the EXISTING durable worker framework; it never spawns a 2nd runtime/worker framework

command_type.description: the existing durable command type this worker handles (e.g. contextops.run_verification) — declared, not newly invented here

proof_scripts.description: REQUIRED — the proof scripts that must PASS before this spec could ever be registered/executed; an empty list is not a valid spec (no worker without a proof)

idempotency_key_template.description: REQUIRED — the deterministic idempotency key template (e.g. 'verify:{fact_key}:{source_hash}') so re-runs collapse rather than duplicate

dlq.description: the dead-letter queue name failed runs land in (no silent drop)

registration_status.description: PINNED proposed — in the lean core nothing auto-registers/executes; MAIN integrates behind a proof gate (red-team: registration_status='active'/'registered' is rejected)

produces.description: pinned — when (later) run, the worker produces a FactVerificationRun (candidate + receipt), never a served fact

requires_human_approval.description: true for high-risk generated code — a human-approval hook gates registration
